patterns.context: Appears in legal discussion referring to redundant hours or improper delay.

patterns.name: Proper names containing und
patterns.context: The trigger occurs in a person’s or place’s name and does not reflect an obvious shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Legal citations, email recipients, historical encyclopedia

2_778.description: 所有段都标出拼写片段“und”，位于不同词形或专名中；触发不依赖统一语义或文体。其他标记词未显示一致的共同条件。

patterns.name: unbundling
patterns.context: 出现在电力监管条款中，描述费率分拆要求。
patterns.domain: 能源政策、合同或监管文本

patterns.name: unfunded
patterns.context: 出现在描述未获资金支持的任务、研究或项目时。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、医疗研究资助

patterns.name: inundated
patterns.context: 表示被大量信息或水淹没；分别用于电视内容涌入和水位淹没聚落。

patterns.name: 法律词汇中的 und
patterns.context: 出现在法律论述中，指冗余工时或不当延误。

patterns.name: 含 und 的专名
patterns.context: 触发位置属于人名或地名，不体现明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 法律引文、邮件收件人、历史百科

en.concept: Judicial title in U.S. legal texts
en.description: Activation clusters around Justice in U.S. legal texts: it refers both to a judge’s title and appears in quotations of opinions, signatures, and names of judicial institutions; it also responds to court rulings, procedural terms, and the formatting at the end of opinions.

patterns.name: Judicial title Justice
patterns.context: A judicial title before a judge’s name, or a position title in an opinion signature; Justice is often followed by a name, surname, or Department.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, legal opinions, and judicial signatures

patterns.name: Judicial quotations and opinion narratives
patterns.context: A judge’s views, opinions, or statements are quoted or paraphrased in legal argument, usually embedded in a case narrative.

patterns.name: Court rulings and procedural terminology
patterns.context: Describes a court ruling, trial, judgment, or appeal proceeding; activation also falls on adjacent legal terms.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and court orders

patterns.name: Opinion signatures and judge-opinion markers
patterns.context: The end of a document lists judges’ names and titles, along with concurring or dissenting opinions, often with uppercase names and typographic separators.
patterns.domain: The end and signature block of court opinions

patterns.name: References to judicial institutions or personnel
patterns.context: Mentions federal judicial bodies, Department of Justice personnel, or the U.S. Supreme Court; not a typical judge-quotation construction.
patterns.domain: Legal news quotations and institutional titles in opinions

2_778.concept: 美国法律文本中的司法称谓
2_778.description: 激活集中于美国法律文本中的 Justice：既指法官头衔，也出现在观点引述、署名与司法机构名称中；同时对法院裁判、程序词及判决结尾格式有反应。

patterns.name: 司法头衔 Justice
patterns.context: 法官姓名之前的司法头衔，或判决署名中的职位称呼；Justice 后常接人名、姓氏或 Department。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律意见及裁判署名

patterns.name: 司法引述与意见叙述
patterns.trigger: « Justice»10 O«'»3Connor argued；« Justice»10« De»1«Young»3；« Justice»10 Hunter stated
patterns.context: 法律论证中引用或转述法官观点、意见或陈述，通常嵌在案件叙事中。

patterns.name: 法院裁判与程序用语
patterns.trigger: « court»3 held；« trial»3« court»3；« judgment»2；« appeal»2
patterns.context: 描述法院的裁判、审判、判决或上诉程序；激活也落在相邻法律术语上。

patterns.name: 判决署名及法官意见标记
patterns.context: 文末列出法官姓名、职衔及协同或异议意见，常伴随大写姓名和排版分隔线。

patterns.name: 司法机构或司法人员提及
patterns.trigger: « FBI»2 agents；« Justice»9 Department；« United»3« States»4« Supreme»3
patterns.context: 提及联邦司法机关、司法部人员或美国最高法院；并非典型法官引述句式。
patterns.domain: 法律新闻引述及判决中的机构称谓

en.description: Activation is concentrated on the judicial title “Justice” in U.S. legal texts, including combinations with names, the title Chief Justice, and opinion attributions; contexts include quoted views, judicial opinions, and signatures.

patterns.name: Judicial title
patterns.context: Appears before or after a judge’s name, commonly in judicial opinion signatures, introductions of opinion authors, or quotations of a judge’s views.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and legal opinions

2_778.description: 激活集中出现在美国法律文本中的法官头衔“Justice”，包括其与姓名、首席法官头衔及意见署名的组合；上下文涵盖引述观点、裁判意见和署名。

patterns.name: 法官头衔
patterns.context: 出现在法官姓名之前或之后，常见于裁判意见署名、意见作者介绍或引述法官观点处。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及法律意见

en.description: All passages activate strongly on “Justice” in legal documents, including judge signatures, titles before names, panel lists, and mentions or quotations of judges in the body; it often co-occurs with formal opinion formatting.

patterns.name: Justice as a judicial title
patterns.context: Justice appears as a judge’s title in court opinions, quoted judgments, or judge lists; it is sometimes followed by a name or period.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal documents

patterns.name: Justice followed by a name or title
patterns.context: Justice appears before a judge’s name, or as a standalone title in an opinion signature, followed by a period.
patterns.domain: Legal opinions, judicial quotations, and signature formats

patterns.name: Formal opinions and court formatting
patterns.context: Appears in opinion layout fields such as names, judicial titles, panel lists, or opinion signatures.
patterns.domain: Titles, signatures, and formatting of court opinions

patterns.name: Justice references in ordinary legal prose
patterns.context: The body discusses or quotes a judge’s view rather than presenting an opinion signature.

2_778.description: 所有段都强烈激活于法律文书中的“Justice”，包括法官署名、姓名前的头衔、合议庭名单，以及正文中提及或引用法官；常与正式判决排版同现。

patterns.name: 司法头衔中的 Justice
patterns.context: 在法院意见书、引述判决或法官名单中，Justice 作为法官头衔出现；有时后接姓名或句点。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律文书

patterns.name: Justice 后接姓名或称谓
patterns.context: Justice 出现在法官姓名前，或作为判决署名中的独立头衔，后接句点。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、司法引述及署名格式

patterns.name: 正式判决及法庭排版
patterns.context: 姓名、法官职务、合议庭名单或意见署名等判决版式字段中。
patterns.domain: 法院判决的标题、署名和排版

patterns.name: 普通法律正文中的 Justice 引述
patterns.context: 正文谈及或引用某位法官的观点，而非判决署名。

en.concept: Judge names and the title Justice
en.description: This neuron responds strongly to the forms surrounding judges’ titles and names in various court decisions, especially a judge’s name before Justice; the material includes decision text, signatures, and opinion letterhead.

patterns.name: Name preceding the title Justice
patterns.context: A judge’s name and the title Justice appear in a legal opinion or decision; the name may precede the title or act as a possessive modifier

2_778.concept: 法官姓名与 Justice 职衔
2_778.description: 该神经元在各类法院判决中对法官称谓及其姓名周边结构强烈激活，尤其是 Justice 前的法官姓名；材料涵盖判决正文、署名和意见书版头。

patterns.name: Justice 职衔前的姓名
patterns.trigger: “Justice»10”，以及前面的法官姓名，如“Justice Hunter”“Justice LONG”“Justice TUNKS”“Justice Clifford's”
patterns.context: 法律意见书或判决文本中出现法官姓名与 Justice 职衔；姓名可在职衔前，也可作为所有格修饰词

en.description: Primarily responds to formatted headings and signature information in U.S. state court opinions: opinion titles, dates, judges and panels, attorneys, and represented parties; it also covers adjacent legal metadata such as prosecutors, addresses, case numbers, and descriptions of panel opinions.

patterns.name: Court and author formatting in opinions
patterns.context: Appears in opinion titles, publication dates, or layout fields identifying the opinion’s author and panel members, often with line breaks, spaces, and uppercase formatting.
patterns.domain: U.S. state court opinions, especially their headings and signature sections

patterns.name: Attorney and party representation information
patterns.context: After an attorney or representative’s name, law firm, or location, indicates representation of an appellant or appellee; sometimes adjacent to a judge’s signature.
patterns.domain: Party and attorney information and case captions in opinions

patterns.name: Names and titles of judges or court officials
patterns.context: Appears before or after a name or title, forming an introduction to a judge, a prosecutor’s signature, or office address information; not all instances are opinion-author formatting.
patterns.domain: Information about judges, prosecutors, and court personnel in legal documents

patterns.name: Date and procedural-stage labels
patterns.context: Indicates the filing date of an opinion, the date of a ruling, or a rehearing stage, usually before the opinion body.
patterns.domain: Dates and procedural information in opinions

patterns.name: Panel opinions and dissenting relationships
patterns.context: States that other judges concur in the judgment, concur in an opinion, or dissent in part, appearing in introductions that assign judges’ opinions.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of panel opinions in court decisions

patterns.name: Case numbers and geographic or institutional address fields
patterns.context: Appears as case numbers or docket metadata such as floor and street addresses, with no direct semantic connection to the opinion body.
patterns.domain: Court docket headings and institutional contact information

2_778.concept: 美国判决书抬头与署名
2_778.description: 主要响应美国州法院判决书的格式化抬头与署名信息：意见标题、日期、法官及合议庭、律师与代理当事人；也覆盖检察官、地址、案号和合议意见说明等相邻法律元数据。

patterns.name: 判决意见书的法院及作者格式
patterns.trigger: “OPINION”“Opinion filed”“JUSTICE … delivered the judgment of the court”“Chief Justice”“Justice”
patterns.context: 出现在意见书标题、意见发布日期或意见撰写者及合议庭成员的版式字段中，常伴随换行、空格和大写排版。
patterns.domain: 美国州法院判决书，尤其是法院意见的抬头和署名部分

patterns.name: 律师及当事人代理信息
patterns.context: 律师或代理人姓名、律所或地点之后，标示其代理上诉人或被上诉人；有时与法官署名相邻。
patterns.domain: 判决书的当事人和律师信息、案卷抬头

patterns.name: 法官或法院官员的姓名职衔
patterns.context: 姓名或职务前后出现，构成法官介绍、检察官署名或办公地址信息；并非都属于意见作者格式。
patterns.domain: 法律文件中的法官、检察机关及法院相关人员信息

patterns.name: 日期及程序阶段标注
patterns.trigger: “filed December 11, 2013”“filed June 16, 2016”“Opinion filed December 21, 2006”“ruled January 31, 1995”“on Rehearing February 11, 1992”
patterns.context: 标明意见书提交日期、裁定日期或重审阶段，通常位于意见正文之前。
patterns.domain: 判决书的日期与程序信息

patterns.name: 合议庭意见及异议关系
patterns.trigger: “concurred in the judgment”“concurred in part and diss…”
patterns.context: 说明其他法官赞同判决、赞同意见或部分异议，出现在法官意见分工的介绍中。
patterns.domain: 法院判决书中的合议意见说明

patterns.name: 案号及地域、机构地址字段
patterns.context: 以案号或楼层、街道地址等案卷元数据形式出现，与意见正文无直接语义联系。
patterns.domain: 法院案卷抬头和机构联系信息

en.concept: Judicial personnel and document structure in court decisions
en.description: Strongly responds to the title Justice and judges’ names, opinion authorship, and panel information in court decisions; also responds to counsel, legal roles and institutional details, decision titles, dates, and formatting. One example also discusses damages.

patterns.name: Justice title and name
patterns.context: Appears in judicial opinion signatures, panel lists, or indications of participation in an opinion; often adjacent to a judge’s name and terms such as delivered, concurred, or took no part.

patterns.name: Opinion authorship and panel information
patterns.context: Indicates which judge authored an opinion and whether other judges concurred or participated; this pattern occurs alongside judicial titles and names.

patterns.name: Counsel for parties and representation labels
patterns.context: After an attorney’s or law firm’s name, role, and location, identifies the party represented; common in attorney lists at the beginning of decisions.

patterns.name: Attorneys, law firms, and prosecution/defense roles
patterns.context: Appears near an attorney’s name or legal institution, indicating a legal role or affiliation.
patterns.domain: Legal personnel lists and case information

patterns.name: Court opinion layout and headings
patterns.context: Headings, case numbers, dates, rulings, or separate-opinion formatting on decision pages; frequent line breaks and blank space may occur.

patterns.name: Courts, prosecutors’ offices, and office addresses
patterns.context: Institution names appear alongside locations, floor numbers, or address information as personnel or institutional contact details.

patterns.name: Legal discussion of compensation and punishment
patterns.context: Discusses compensatory damages and punitive effects, the court’s authority, and judicial control; not an attorney list or decision-signature format.

patterns.name: Large blank spaces and layout filler
patterns.context: Blank space and divider lines around judge lists, signatures, or opinion headings; may reflect formatting rather than semantic content.

2_778.concept: 法律判决中的司法人员与文书结构
2_778.description: 强烈响应法律判决中的Justice称谓及法官姓名、意见撰写和合议庭信息；也响应律师代理方、法律职务与机构资料、判决标题日期和版式。另见一处赔偿论述。

patterns.name: Justice 职衔及姓名
patterns.context: 出现在司法意见的署名、合议庭名单或意见参与情况中；常与法官姓名、delivered、concurred、took no part 等相邻。

patterns.name: 意见撰写与合议庭信息
patterns.context: 说明哪位法官撰写意见、其他法官是否赞同或参与；该模式与法官称谓及姓名共同出现。

patterns.name: 案件当事方律师及代理标注
patterns.context: 律师或律所姓名、职务与地点后，标明其代表的诉讼一方；常见于判决开头的律师名单。

patterns.name: 律师、律所及公诉辩护职务
patterns.context: 出现在律师姓名或法律机构名称附近，标示法律职务或所属单位。
patterns.domain: 法律人员名录与判决案头信息

patterns.name: 法院意见版式与标题
patterns.context: 判决页面的标题、案号、日期、裁判结果或独立意见版式；大量换行和留白可能伴随出现。

patterns.name: 法院、检察机关及办公地址
patterns.trigger: «Cuyahoga County Prosecutor»、«The Justice Center»、«8th Floor»、«1200 Ontario»
patterns.context: 机构名称与地点、楼层或地址信息并列，属于人员或机构联系资料。

patterns.name: 赔偿与惩罚的法律论述
patterns.trigger: «capacity to inject punishment under the guise of a compensatory award»
patterns.context: 讨论补偿性赔偿与惩罚性效果、法院权限及司法控制；不是律师名单或判决署名格式。

patterns.name: 大段空白及排版填充
patterns.context: 法官名单、署名或意见标题周围的版式留白和分隔线；可能反映格式而非语义内容。

en.description: Activation clusters around judicial vocabulary and titles in legal documents: opinions, judge and court information, and attorney and prosecutor lists; a few instances occur in statutory interpretation and testimony to a judicial committee.

patterns.name: Opinion titles and adjudicator identity
patterns.context: In the title, signature, or adjudicator introduction of a court opinion; Justice is often followed by a name or title

patterns.name: Dates and panel lists on the first page of court documents
patterns.context: On the first page of an opinion, judges’ names and titles are listed after the date

patterns.name: Judicial personnel, prosecutors, and their titles
patterns.context: In signatures or lists of judicial or prosecutorial personnel, names, institutions, and positions
patterns.domain: Legal documents and judicial institution directories

patterns.name: Interpretation and statutory provisions in legal discussion
patterns.context: Discusses statutory interpretation and its effects on existing law or compensation rules

patterns.name: Mention of a criminal justice committee in testimony
patterns.context: A committee is mentioned in written testimony about the rate at which prison staff at private prisons are attacked by inmates

patterns.name: Legal representatives and party lists
patterns.context: Lists attorneys, their organizations, and the parties they represent

patterns.name: Prosecutor contact information and address formatting
patterns.context: A prosecutor’s name, position, and office address are listed in sequence
patterns.domain: Prosecutor document signatures or contact information

2_778.concept: 法律文书中的司法标记
2_778.description: 激活集中于法律文书中的司法语汇与人员职衔：意见书、法官及审判庭信息、律师和检察官名录；少数出现在法条解释及司法委员会证词语境。

patterns.name: 法院意见书的标题与裁判者身份
patterns.context: 法院意见书的标题、签署或裁判者介绍处；Justice 后常接姓名或职务

patterns.name: 法院文书首页的日期及审判庭名单
patterns.context: 判决书首页，在日期之后列出法官姓名与职衔

patterns.name: 司法人员、检察官及其职衔
patterns.context: 司法或检察人员姓名、机构与职位的署名或名录中
patterns.domain: 法律文书及司法机构名录

patterns.name: 法律论述中的解释与法律条文
patterns.context: 讨论法条解释及其对既有法律或补偿规则的影响

patterns.name: 证词中提及刑事司法委员会
patterns.context: 关于私人监狱工作人员遭囚犯袭击比例的书面证词中提及委员会

patterns.name: 法律代理人及诉讼当事人名录
patterns.context: 列出律师、所属机构及其代理的诉讼方

patterns.name: 检方联系信息与地址排版
patterns.context: 检察官姓名、职位和办公地址连续列示
patterns.domain: 检方文书署名或联系信息

en.description: Activation primarily occurs on Justice in legal contexts (a judicial title or institution name) and the fixed phrase “Suffice it to say” in decisions; consumer-protection complaint terminology also appears.

patterns.name: Fixed wording in judicial opinions
patterns.context: Appears in court-opinion sentences discussing evidence or case procedure; “it” in the phrase activates most strongly

patterns.name: Justice title
patterns.context: Appears as a judicial title or position; activation is concentrated on Justice
patterns.domain: Court opinions, legal decisions, and related judicial texts

patterns.name: Justice department name in legal documents
patterns.context: Justice appears in a government attorney’s signature or an institution name

patterns.name: Justice Center institution name
patterns.context: Appears in the header or address of a county prosecutor’s document

patterns.name: Criminal justice terminology
patterns.context: Appears alongside offenders, intervention programs, and judicial institutions as a policy or research field term

patterns.name: Other isolated triggers in legal documents
patterns.context: Claims and damages language in a consumer-protection complaint; no clear connection to Justice or fixed judicial wording

2_778.concept: 法律语境中的 Justice/司法措辞
2_778.description: 激活主要落在法律语境的 Justice（法官职衔或司法机构名称）及判决中的固定短语 “Suffice it to say”；另有消费者保护诉状术语。

patterns.name: 司法意见固定措辞
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见讨论证据或案件程序的句子中，短语中的 “it” 激活最强

patterns.name: Justice 职衔
patterns.context: 作为法官职衔或司法职位名称出现；激活集中在 Justice
patterns.domain: 法院意见、法律判决及相关司法文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 Justice 部门名称
patterns.context: 政府律师署名或机构名称中出现 Justice

patterns.name: Justice Center 机构名称
patterns.context: 出现在县检察官文件的页眉或机构地址中

patterns.name: 刑事司法术语
patterns.context: 与犯罪者、干预项目及司法机构并列，作为政策或研究领域术语出现

patterns.name: 法律文书中其他孤立触发
patterns.context: 消费者保护诉状的请求与损害赔偿表述；未见与 Justice 或固定司法措辞的明确联系

en.description: Primarily activates on two types of within-word fragments: treble damages in legal contexts and Certain at the beginning of a sentence; it also activates at a closing brace in a JSON passage. Its triggering meanings and genres are not consistent.

patterns.name: Legal damages terminology
patterns.context: Appears in a civil complaint or claim narrative, referring to a request for punitive or statutory multiple damages.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Certain
patterns.context: Certain at the beginning of a sentence introduces a group of people, patents, randomization schemes, effects, carriers, or compounds; activation focuses on the internal certain subword.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, academic papers, corporate emails, code, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: JSON closing braces
patterns.context: Activates at consecutive closing braces at the end of a nested JSON error response or configuration snippet.

2_778.description: 主要激活两类词内子串：法律语境的 treble damages，以及句首 Certain；另在一段 JSON 的闭合花括号处激活。其触发词义与文体并不统一。

patterns.name: 法律损害赔偿用语
patterns.context: 出现在民事诉状或索赔叙述中，指请求惩罚性或法定倍数损害赔偿。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、法律相关邮件

patterns.name: Certain 句首词
patterns.context: 句首以 Certain 引出一组人、专利、随机化方案、效果、载体或化合物；激活集中在词内部的 certain 子串。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、学术论文、企业邮件、代码、百科条目

patterns.name: JSON 闭合括号
patterns.context: 嵌套 JSON 错误响应或配置片段末尾的连续右花括号处激活。

en.concept: Local text fragments and formatting boundaries
en.description: Activation is scattered across within-word fragments, numeric formats, punctuation and line breaks, uppercase legal terms, and code prompts; examples include names, legal texts, web comments, German records, and species names, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Morpheme fragments within compound words
patterns.context: Within words or proper names, especially at subword boundaries, word endings, or fragments surrounded by other text; token positions vary and common fragments include ith, ent, g, eas, ris.
patterns.domain: Legal, email, species names, and general text

patterns.name: Numbers and decimal formats
patterns.context: Numbers appear in ratings, decimals, statute numbers, years, or item numbers; sometimes the number itself activates, sometimes adjacent formatting does.

patterns.name: Punctuation and layout boundaries
patterns.context: Markers fall on boundary symbols such as line breaks, commas, periods, or parentheses, often adjacent to layout or formatting structure.
patterns.domain: Code, legal documents, reviews, and web text

patterns.name: Emphatic headings or uppercase legal terms
patterns.context: Uppercase words or fragments within uppercase words; in some examples they belong to legal institutions, litigation roles, or agreement titles.

patterns.name: Success prompts in program output
patterns.context: Code calls MessageBox.Show to display a victory prompt with an exclamation mark; activation spans the string boundary and a fragment of success.

patterns.name: German word-form fragments
patterns.context: In German parliamentary speeches, the fragment appears within a complete word or at its end; line breaks and speaker labels are also present.
patterns.domain: German records of the European Parliament

patterns.name: Legal document structure and local fragments in names
patterns.context: Appears in the headings, parties, and judge information of court opinions or orders; activation involves both legal terms and fragments within names.

patterns.name: Web forms and agreement headings

patterns.name: Legal citations and publication information
patterns.context: In statutory cross-references and publisher names, activation is near citation punctuation or a fragment within Legal.

patterns.name: Fragments in biological species names
patterns.context: In scientific or common species names, activation occurs at noncontiguous positions within words, near a list of California species.

patterns.name: Ratings and dates in tables or reviews
patterns.context: Near star ratings, dates, and verified-purchaser information in product or service reviews.

patterns.name: Contract clauses and business email fragments
patterns.context: Ordinary word or name fragments appear in discussions of contract termination, meeting times, and business correspondence.

patterns.name: Land rights abbreviations and business emails

en.concept: Proper names and structural markers in text
en.description: Activation often falls on letter fragments within proper names, especially personal names; also appears on email headers, quotation marks and transaction-record fields, as well as encyclopedia categories/geographical terms and legal formatting. Patterns are sporadic, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Letter fragments within personal names
patterns.context: Activation falls on letter fragments within names of people or places, often where proper names are split into multiple tokens; the fragment need not correspond to a complete word.
patterns.domain: People lists, email recipients/body, legal decisions, place descriptions

patterns.name: Email formatting markers and separators
patterns.context: Appears in email headers, subject lines, quoted replies, or line-break/separator positions; mostly in email corpora, with a few similar line-break markers in encyclopedia lists.
patterns.domain: Enron email formatting; encyclopedia list layout

patterns.name: Email business terms and record fields
patterns.context: Appears in email discussions of counterparties, pending credit matters, transaction numbers, or error records; many activations fall on field terms or number fragments.
patterns.domain: Enron business/energy-trading emails and similar business records

patterns.name: Relational words in encyclopedia categories and lists
patterns.context: Appears on short function words in biographies, category headings, or geographical entries; activation is weak and co-occurs with fragments within personal names.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia people lists, category headings, geographical entries

patterns.name: Country and region-related word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in sports teams, football categories, or geographical descriptions, referring to countries, regions, or geographical names.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia sports categories and geographical entries

patterns.name: Litigant names and judgment formatting in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears near court judgment titles, party designations, and court information; this feature also activates on «Keith» within a personal name.

patterns.name: Quoted lines in a cooking conversation
patterns.context: In a reply email, quoted content is marked by repeated > symbols; the quoted text discusses homemade chili and beans. Activation concentrates on the quotation format and name fragments.

2_778.concept: 文本中的专名与结构标记
2_778.description: 激活多落在专名内部的字母片段，尤其是人名；另见邮件头、引用符和交易记录字段，以及百科分类/地理词和法律格式。模式分散，未见单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 人名内部的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名或地名内部的字母片段上；常见于专名被切分成多个 token 的位置，片段不一定对应完整词。
patterns.domain: 人物名单、邮件收件人/正文、法律判决、地名介绍

patterns.name: 邮件格式标记与分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头、主题行、引用回复或换行/分隔位置；主要见于邮件语料，少量类似换行标记也出现在百科列表。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件格式；百科列表排版

patterns.name: 邮件业务术语与记录字段
patterns.context: 邮件讨论交易对手、待处理信用事项、交易编号或错误记录时出现；不少激活落在字段词或编号片段上。
patterns.domain: Enron 商务/能源交易邮件及类似业务记录

patterns.name: 百科分类和列表中的关系词
patterns.trigger: « former»；« in»；« States»；« Except»；« for»；« a»
patterns.context: 出现在人物简介、类别标题或地理条目中的短功能词；激活较弱，且与人名内部片段并存。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物列表、分类标题、地理条目

patterns.name: 国名及地域相关词片段
patterns.context: 出现在运动队、足球分类或地理描述中，指向国家、地区或地理名称。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 体育分类与地理条目

patterns.name: 法律文书的诉讼称谓与判决格式
patterns.context: 法院判决标题、当事人称谓及法院信息附近出现；此段也激活了人名内部的 «Keith»。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院判决文本

patterns.name: 烹饪对话中的引用行
patterns.context: 回复邮件中以连续 > 标记引用内容，引用正文谈到自制辣椒和豆类；激活集中在引用格式及人名片段。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的非正式对话

en.concept: Within-word character fragments and formatting fragments
en.description: Activation mainly falls on character fragments within diverse words, such as Shrewsbury, starred, NEIGHBORHOOD, and Sue; sporadic activations also occur on common words, punctuation, line breaks, and formula symbols. There is no consistent semantic or contextual condition across corpora.

patterns.name: Shrewsbury spelling fragment
patterns.context: Shrewsbury/Shrewdness appears in a place name or book title; activation concentrates on a marked fragment within the word. Letters following “Shrew” may also activate.

patterns.name: Suffix or letter fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within different words: starred, NEIGHBORHOOD, Chacko, Sian, Sue; no unified lexical meaning or syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Formula symbol fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the mathematical/typographic expression “10$\mu$m” for a wavelength unit.

patterns.name: Punctuation or formatting tokens
patterns.context: Sporadic activations occur at formatting positions such as line breaks, semicolons, quotation marks, and spaces, with no stable semantic condition.

patterns.name: Common short words or word endings
patterns.context: Some common words in full or as within-word fragments activate sporadically; their contexts and meanings differ considerably, with no reliable common condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, bibliographies, book reviews, papers, biographies

2_778.concept: 词内字符片段及格式碎片
2_778.description: 激活主要落在多样词语的内部字符片段，如 Shrewsbury、starred、NEIGHBORHOOD、Sue，也零星出现在普通词、标点换行和公式符号；跨语料缺少一致语义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: Shrewsbury 拼写片段
patterns.context: 地名或书名中出现 Shrewsbury/Shrewdness，激活集中在被拆分标记的词内部片段；“Shrew”后续字母也可能激活。
patterns.domain: 地理条目、书目/小说目录

patterns.name: 词内后缀或字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在多种不同词的内部片段：starred、NEIGHBORHOOD、Chacko、Sian、Sue；看不出统一的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 评论、法律标题、人物简介、邮件

patterns.name: 公式符号片段
patterns.context: 出现在波长单位的数学/排版表达式“10$\mu$m”中。

patterns.name: 标点或格式 token
patterns.context: 换行、分号、引用符号或空格等格式位置有零星激活，未见稳定语义条件。
patterns.domain: 法律引文、电子邮件、评论文字

patterns.name: 常见短词或词尾
patterns.context: 若干普通词的完整形式或词内片段偶发激活，彼此上下文与语义差异很大，未显出可靠共同条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、书目、书评、论文、人物介绍

en.description: High activations fall on highly disparate within-word fragments: rew, red, ales, the surname fragment erz, ing, and ary; the corpora and contexts also vary, making it difficult to group them under one semantic or stable word-form pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word suffix “rew”
patterns.context: The triggering fragment is split by tokenization and occurs in the place name Shrewsbury.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment “rew”
patterns.context: The triggering fragment appears in the book title Shrewdness, marked as a split token.

patterns.name: Word-final “red”
patterns.context: Appears in the word starred in a book-review quotation; the within-word substring is marked.

patterns.name: Word-final “ales”
patterns.context: Appears in discussion of apartment resales in the real estate market.

patterns.name: Surname fragment “erz”
patterns.context: The name Sw erz bin is marked as split; it recurs in the same email corpus.

patterns.name: “ing” in a name
patterns.context: Appears in the basketball player’s surname Swing.

patterns.name: Word-final “red”
patterns.context: Appears in an account of an actor performing with George Clooney.

patterns.name: Word-final “ary”
patterns.context: Appears in a formal description of materials and procedures required by traffic regulations.

2_778.description: 高激活落在彼此差异很大的词内片段上：rew、red、ales、姓氏片段erz、ing及ary；语料和语境也各不相同，难以归并为单一语义或稳定词形模式。

patterns.name: 词内后缀“rew”
patterns.context: 触发片段被分词拆开，位于地名 Shrewsbury 中。

patterns.name: 词内片段“rew”
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在书名 Shrewdness 内，词被拆分标记。

patterns.name: 词尾“red”

patterns.context: 出现在公寓转售（resales）的房地产市场讨论中。

patterns.name: 姓氏片段“erz”
patterns.context: 姓名 Sw erz bin 被拆分标记；同一邮件语料中重复出现。

patterns.name: 名字中的“ing”

patterns.name: 词尾“red”

patterns.name: 词尾“ary”
patterns.context: 出现在交通法规所需材料和程序的正式说明中。

en.description: Primarily activates on specific letter fragments within words: rew, ing, ian, ical, iss, and the email name fragments Rich and er; there are also sporadic activations on common words, punctuation, and line breaks, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Within-word substring “rew”
patterns.context: All trigger positions are the letter substring rew within a word; they occur in the place name Shrewsbury and the common word shrewdness, in different surrounding contexts

patterns.name: Within-word substring “ing”
patterns.context: Triggered by the substring ing in proper names or titles; appears in the name Swing and the album title Swingtime

patterns.name: Within-word substring “ian”
patterns.context: The consecutive letters ian in the place name or personal name Sian Berry

patterns.name: Within-word substring “ical”
patterns.context: Triggered within words ending in ical, such as topical and comical; both words occur next to each other in one context

patterns.name: Within-word substring “iss”
patterns.context: Triggered by the substring iss in Swiss; both occurrences are in category names

patterns.name: Name fragment “Rich”
patterns.context: Triggered on the initial fragment of the name Richter, which appears twice in the same email segment

patterns.name: Within-word fragment “er”
patterns.context: Triggered on the substring er in the name Sw erzbin; no shared context is evident in other segments

patterns.name: Sporadic common words and punctuation
patterns.context: Low-intensity activation is scattered across common words, punctuation, and line breaks, without stable local semantic or syntactic conditions across segments

2_778.description: 主要激活词内特定字母片段：rew、ing、ian、ical、iss，以及邮件姓名片段 Rich、er；另有多处零散常见词、标点和换行激活，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 词内子串“rew”
patterns.context: 触发位置都是单词内部的字母子串 rew；分别出现在地名 Shrewsbury 和普通词 shrewdness 中，周围语境不同

patterns.name: “ing”词内子串

patterns.name: “ian”词内子串

patterns.name: “ical”词内子串
patterns.context: 触发在 topical、comical 等以 ical 结尾的词内部；一个语境中两词相邻出现

patterns.name: “iss”词内子串
patterns.context: 触发在 Swiss 中的 iss 子串；两次都位于分类名称中

patterns.name: “Rich”姓名片段

en.description: Activation mainly falls on local character fragments within words rather than stable syntactic positions or semantic topics, including rew, Swiss, swans, Useful, pejorative, and casual. Only Swiss recurs across multiple segments, concentrated in category labels for Swiss athletes.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Shrewsbury

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Swiss

patterns.name: Plural ending s/ans

patterns.name: Fragment within pejorative

patterns.name: Fragment within incidental

2_778.description: 激活位置主要落在词内部的局部字符片段，而非稳定的句法位置或语义主题：包括 rew、Swiss、swans、Useful、pejorative、casual 等；只有 Swiss 在多段中重复，并集中于瑞士运动员分类标签。

patterns.name: Shrewsbury 词内片段

patterns.name: Swiss 词内片段

patterns.name: 复数词尾 s/ans

en.concept: Within-word letter fragments and formatting symbols
en.description: Activation clusters notably around within-word fragments such as rew, ical, and iss, but also appears on email names/endings, code-comment fragments, parentheses, and various punctuation marks. Sporadic markers are difficult to group under a unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment “rew”
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the consecutive letter fragment rew in the middle of complete words; the two examples occur in a place name and a book title.

patterns.name: Word ending “ical”
patterns.context: Appears on the ending fragment ical in the adjective comical; one example describes a screen character, the other evaluates a comedy performance.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment “iss”
patterns.context: Activation is on iss in the nationality adjective Swiss, in both cases in category or event-related text.

patterns.name: Name endings in email
patterns.context: Activation falls on word endings or fragments within names in email body text or signatures; the two examples show no stable shared lexical condition.

patterns.name: Fragment “ful” in code comments
patterns.context: In a code comment explaining parser functionality, activation is on a fragment within the word useful.

patterns.name: Closing parenthesis
patterns.context: Activation occurs on closing parentheses in code calls or ordinary text; examples are sparse and lack a shared context.

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting symbols
patterns.context: Multiple periods, spaces, line breaks, colons, or separator lines in email segments are marked, but no consistent local linguistic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Other short fragments
patterns.context: These words or short fragments appear sporadically in different syntactic positions, with no identifiable shared trigger condition.

2_778.concept: 词内字母片段及格式符号

patterns.name: 词内片段“rew”

patterns.name: 词内片段“iss”

patterns.name: 邮件中的人名尾部

patterns.name: 代码注释中的片段“ful”
patterns.context: 在解释解析器功能的代码注释中，激活位于单词 useful 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 括号闭合符号

patterns.name: 标点与格式符号

patterns.name: 其他短片段
patterns.context: 这些词或短片段零散出现在不同句法位置，未呈现可确认的共同触发条件。

en.concept: Within-word fragments and the comical ending

2_778.concept: 词内片段与 comical 词尾

patterns.name: The string shrew within a word
patterns.context: Activation falls on the consecutive characters “rew” within a word; they appear in the place name Shrewsbury and the title/word Shrewdness, without depending on the same sentence meaning.

patterns.name: The string opt within a word

patterns.name: The string ri within a word

patterns.name: Email formatting and line breaks
